open-trigger.tooltip: Hover opens the pocket when the mouse rests on the pocket button; click needs a click.

hover-delay.tooltip: Only used when the pocket opens on hover.

close-delay.description: Delay before closing after the mouse left
close-delay.tooltip: Only used when the pocket opens on hover.

hidden-apps.description: Programs to move into the pocket
hidden-apps.tooltip: Use the icon's role/WM_CLASS (case-insensitive), e.g. dropbox or steam. Open Looking Glass (Alt+F2, lg) > Log and look for 'PocketTray: icon role' to see the names.
